sections.text: Introduction

This document lists the major maintenance procedures P2, which must be 
performed every twenty years as indicated by Y20 in the title block

The first draft initiated by eng. Mohamed Abdel-Azez, 
 accepted by general director eng. Ahmed Ebrahem Soliman, and 
 certified by eng. Esam Sadeq: Alx 
 Network general director and MPIS coordinator.
Safety Precautions
CB must be fully isolated
Control power disconnected

Grounding switch must be closed on both sides of CB to ensure it is properly 
 grounded

Personal protective equipment must be used ( safety shoes, helmet, breathing 
 mask, safety glasses)

Maintenance staff should be well trained and qualified or directly supervised 
 by some one who is

Caution marks must be hanged on the work place, safety rope around the work 
 place

items:
A work permit must be issued and the qualified maintenance staff should carry the 
 suitable safety category
Safety fence with caution marks surrounding the work area is required
Wear your safety and healthy equipment as safety helmet, safety shoes, ... etc

sections.text: Work to be Carried Out

Record number of 
make-break operation (as per operation counter or requested by system 
management)
Carry out visual check

Record any special events 
(as requested by system management)

Check hydraulic operating 
system for external leakage (pipes, valves, etc)

Check hydraulic operating 
system for internal leakage in on and off positions 
(pressure loss per hour at nominal pressure and with oil pump set switched off)

Check gas filling of main 
module using 
a precision pressure gauge

Check reading of pressure 
gauge 45.129(1-1510) for gas and 45.209 (1-1510) for pressurized oil at nominal 
pressure against readings of precision pressure gauge

Check gas density monitor 
45.135(1-1510) using the service unit of the SF6 filling device A2 ("loss of SF6 
"and" general lockout (SF6)")
Pump gas out of main module

Gradually reduce oil 
pressure in hydraulic system to zero. Checking the operation of pressure 
monitors for lockouts and signals
No.5 "General lockout )oil)"
No.6 "Lockout (oil)"
No 7 "oil delivery faulted"

Remove cover of man way 
opening 5.115 (1-0410) in partition plate 5.105 (1-0410) and prepare circuit - 
breaker module for withdrawal

Mount W345 truck assembly 
on circuit - breaker module

Undo partition plates 
5.105 (1 - 0410) and remove circuit - breaker module

Clean all the poles 
including their operating rods (switching dust)

From an interrupter unit 
5.261(1-0610) (remove fixed contact tube support 5.261.11 together with fixed 
contact tube 5.261.25 (1-0810) and check. In the On start also inspect guide 
tube 5.261.33 and the front end of blast cylinder 5.261.41 (10-810)

If any damage is found 
dismantle, inspect and if necessary repair the other two interrupter units as 
well

Replace all three coupling 
contacts 5.269 (1-0510).Clean coupling contacts and contact pieces 437.7 
(1-0388) and grease sparingly

Reinsert circuit - breaker 
module and bolt partition plate 5.105 (1-0410) to the chamber of the main module

Remove W 345 truck 
assembly

Reach through the man way 
opening 5.111 (1-0410). Connect up tile flexible copper links 5.249.11 and 
5.253.11(1-0510) and refit shielding plate 36.75 of earthling switch 35.11 
(1-0388)

Place new filter bags in 
box 5.119(1-0410) and fit the covers 5.115 (1-0410)

Connect hose of service 
unit to maintenance point 45.107 (1-1510) in automatic control unit of the 
circuit breaker, evacuate main module and fill with gas

Check oil level in oil 
tank 5.27 (1-0410) (hydraulic operating system pressure less off state)

In this state check pipe 
couplings of hydraulic operating system retighten as necessary using a torque 
wrench see "General installation instructions"

Take oil sample frame 
bottom of tank 5.27 (1-0410) at oil drain plug 5.137.141.15 (1-1210) and examine 
(red and clear = good condition, opaque and miky state = poor condition, record 
result)

Drain oil from hydraulic 
operating system, clean oil tank and wash out filter 5.27.49 (1-1210)

Refill with new hydraulic 
oil

Vent hydraulic operating 
system including oil pump

Start oil pump set, 
5.137,+5.137.339 (1-1210) and check priming pressure of nitrogen filling in 
hydraulic storage cylinder 5.33(1-0410) using a precision gauge

If necessary replenish 
nitrogen filling in hydraulic storage cylinder 5.33 (1-0410)

With rising and felling 
oil pressure check pressure monitors for correct operation (lockouts and 
signals):
No .4 "General lockout (N2)"
No .5 "General lockout (oil)"
No .6 "Lockout (oil)"
No .7 Oil delivery faulted"

Check safety valve 
45.24911(1-1510) (opening and closing pressure)

Replace position switch 
S2, part No 5.137 .303.9(1-1210), of volume switch 5.137.303 on electric motor 
5.137.321 (1-1210) of the oil pump set

Lightly oil sliding 
surfaces of mechanism parts between main valve 137.141 (1-1210) and auxiliary 
switch 137.369(1-1210), and also on /off indicator 137.429 (1-1210). Check all 
mechanism parts. (Do not oil auxiliary switch)

Check the closing magnets 
137.51and tripping magnets 137.69. (1-1210) of the control valve blocks : 
terminals, condition aluminum ring (setscrew), magnets firmly tightened

Check effect of electric 
heaters, heaters, e.g. 45.199 (1-1510), without carrying out measurement

Check to see that all 
connections to terminals and contractors, etc are tightened
Carry out test operations

Test for correct 
functioning:
Operate breaker, check signals and lockouts, anti-pumping feature, on-off 
indicators, ... etc
(This test normally extends to the control room console)

measure pressure of gas 
filling (final check)

Check all remade joints 
(covers and flanges) for any signs of leakage. (Final check)

Check oil level in tank 
(final check)

Check hydraulic operating 
system for external leakage (final check)

Secure pressure release 
valve 45.149.17(1-1510)(final check)

Measure moisture air 
contact of the gas (final check)

Measure air contact of the 
gas (final check)

Paint finish and 
anti-corrosion protection to be touched up by customer's personnel
